name: Aena S.M.E., S.A.
tagline: Europe's leading airport operator managing major transport hubs across Spain and international destinations
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue represents Aena's primary operational metric, reflecting airport activity levels across its network. At 1,238 million euros for H1 2020, it captures the significant pandemic-driven decline in passenger traffic and airport services.

kpis.explanation: Total revenue generated by the company during the period.
kpis.signal: Revenue decline due to 2020 pandemic impact
kpis.description: Revenue for the six-month period ended 30 June 2020 amounts to 1,238 million euros. Data extracted from condensed consolidated interim financial statements.

kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.signal: High gross margin despite crisis conditions
kpis.description: Gross margin stands at 58.2% for the six-month period ended 30 June 2020, demonstrating operational resilience despite pandemic disruptions.

kpis.signal: Resilient operating margin despite pandemic headwinds
kpis.description: Operating margin is 22.1% for the half-year period, reflecting effective cost management during a challenging operating environment.

kpis.explanation: Capital spending on property, plant and equipment and intangible assets.
kpis.signal: Capex maintained despite crisis to support infrastructure
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reached 189 million euros during the first half of 2020, demonstrating ongoing commitment to airport infrastructure modernization and expansion.

kpis.signal: Cash position significantly strengthened through liquidity preservation measures
kpis.description: Cash and cash equivalents reached 2,184 million euros at 30 June 2020, compared to 241 million euros at 31 December 2019, driven by proactive liquidity management and pandemic-related financing activities.
